name: Domon Seijirou
source:
A member of Homura's father team.

Lighter: he can light up dark places and use it against enemies.

Fears: bugs, beasts, guts.

[spoiler]Rikana is his favourite workmate. He will enter in 'desperation mode' if he watches Rikana's corpse.[/spoiler]

Family: father (doctor); mother; older sister.
